pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: Gaya and Nalanda 2022 2023 show institutional delivery and postnatal percentages of registrations
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Gaya' THEN institutional_deliveries ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Gaya' THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS gaya_institutional_delivery_percentage, (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Gaya' THEN postnatal_check_48h ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Gaya' THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS gaya_postnatal_percentage, (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Nalanda' THEN institutional_deliveries ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Nalanda' THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS nalanda_institutional_delivery_percentage, (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Nalanda' THEN postnatal_check_48h ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN district = 'Nalanda' THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS nalanda_postnatal_percentage FROM maternal_services WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
